metadata.name: gallery_route
metadata.description: A grounded itinerary for a demonstration museum.

tools.name: visit_planner

function.description: Plan a museum route with a time budget, access needs and exhibit preferences.

tools.instructions: Start by checking the visitor's time budget. If the visitor has not supplied a duration, respond only with 'How many minutes do you have for your visit?' End the turn without calling tools. Exhibit preferences are optional. With a duration, call website_plan_visit if available. Pass the duration, access constraints, and only the preferred exhibit IDs the visitor named: paper, sound, textiles, light. After a successful call, output result.itinerary verbatim. Never make up stops or times. If the route action is unavailable, explain that the host route calculator is required. This is a synthetic venue.

tools.name: route_specialist

function.description: Check a time budget, access preferences and missed exhibits before reporting an itinerary.

tools.instructions: If the visitor has not provided a duration, ask 'How many minutes do you have for your visit?' Exhibit preferences are optional. When the duration is known and the website provides website_plan_visit, call it using the visitor's constraints. Exhibit IDs are paper for Paper Works, sound for Sound Lab, textiles for Textile Archive, and light for Light Studio. Copy result.itinerary verbatim after success. The duration includes walking back to the Entrance. Avoid promising availability, opening hours, or access characteristics outside tool data.
